sec: Causes of portal HTN: pre-hepatic and post-hepatic · p1002

items.q: Pre-hepatic portal hypertension corresponds to occlusion of the:
opts: 1st order portal vein (AKA extrahepatic portal venous obstruction, EHPVO)
3rd order portal vein, the intrahepatic branching point
Hepatic vein outflow (the Budd–Chiari, post-hepatic territory)
The sinusoids themselves, as in the cirrhotic pattern
items.exp: Pre-hepatic: first order portal vein occlusion AKA extrahepaticportal venous obstruction (EHPVO). (Book p1002)

items.q: Match the printed features of EHPVO — 1) Bleed  2) Spleen  3) Liver  4) Prognosis … A) No cirrhosis  B) Massive splenomegaly  C) Severe upper gastrointestinal  D) Good
items.exp: Characteristic features: severe upper gastrointestinal bleed, massive splenomegaly; no cirrhosis (good prognosis). (Book p1002)

items.q: Post-hepatic portal hypertension, cause ‘a’, is hepatic vein obstruction, also known as:
items.exp: Post-hepatic a. cause: hepatic vein obstruction AKA Budd Chiari syndrome. (Book p1002)

items.q: The classical findings of Budd–Chiari syndrome printed on p1002 are ascites and:
items.exp: Classical findings: ascites, hepatomegaly (note: hepatomegaly, not splenomegaly). (Book p1002)

items.q: Match the post-hepatic ‘other causes’ (right heart failure) of p1002 — 1) Valvular  2) Myocardial  3) Pericardial … A) Constrictive pericarditis (↑ JVP)  B) Restrictive cardiomyopathy  C) Tricuspid regurgitation
items.exp: Right heart failure: tricuspid regurgitation, restrictive cardiomyopathy, constrictive pericarditis (↑ JVP). (Book p1002)

items.q: A patient with constrictive pericarditis and a raised JVP develops ascites and portal pressure elevation. In the p1002 classification this falls under:
items.exp: Constrictive pericarditis (↑ JVP) is listed under post-hepatic → b. other causes → right heart failure. (Book p1002)

items.q: Which of the following is the RARE cause of EHPVO listed on p1002?
items.exp: Causes: umbilical sepsis (listed without qualifier) and splenic vein thrombosis (rare). (Book p1002)
